name: Auroral Ascent (R)
author: rnexel
description: Go below the cube portal as the mini wave at 4%. Play until 12% as mini (jump as late as possible at 5% to reach the gravity portal). Skip the cube portal at 12% and navigate through the following section as a UFO. Fall above the level at between the platforms at 16%. Stay near the ceiling for the rest of the level.
